newsitem.title: USA: Law firm files suit against Diana Corp.
newsitem.headline: Law firm files suit against Diana Corp.

text.p: A law firm said it has filed a class-action lawsuit against Diana Corp, accusing the company of misrepresenting the nature and capability of two telecommunications products.

The law firm of Pomerantz Haudek Block & Grossman said in a statement that the lawsuit concerns the DSS Switch and DataNet products that the company's Sattel Communications unit "had allegedly developed and was purportedly marketing around the world."
The company was not immediately available for comment.
The law firm said the suit was filed on behalf of people who purchased Diana Corp stock between January 5, 1996, and March 7, 1997.
